name: lokal-skills
description: Lokal's shared Claude Code skills for org-wide, technology-agnostic coding standards.

plugins.name: basic-repo-standards
plugins.description: Identify each project/app in a repo and make sure each has a real README.md, a CLAUDE.md with the baseline coding-standards goal statement, .gitignore coverage for env files plus a .env.example, and GitHub Actions CI covering the repo's actual working branches — fixing any gaps directly, then writing a BASIC_REPO_STANDARDS.md report.
